# Effects

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

The effect flags of one rule. Unset fields take the action's default.

Appears at: `/policy/unknown/effects`, `/rule_sets/rules/effects`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `help_url` | string | no |  | 1 to 2048 characters; matches `^https://` | 1.0.0 | A link shown with the notification: an `https` URL of at most 2048 bytes. Only allowed when a notification is shown. |
| `log` | [`LogLevel`](types.md#loglevel) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | Whether the decision produces a local event. `deny`, `audit`, `allow_elevated` and `trust_source` need an event per decision, so `summary` and `never` are not allowed on them. |
| `notification_text` | string | no |  | 1 to 2048 characters | 1.0.0 | The text of a `custom` notification: at most 2048 characters, with the placeholders `{file}`, `{publisher}`, `{rule}`, `{user}` and `{hash}`. Write `{{` and `}}` for literal braces. Required with `notify: custom`, and only allowed with it. |
| `notify` | [`Notify`](types.md#notify) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | Whether the user is shown a notification. |
| `severity` | [`EventSeverity`](types.md#eventseverity) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | How serious the event is, for alerting (#16). |
| `suppress_duplicates_secs` | integer | no |  | 0 to 604800; format `uint32` | 1.0.0 | The local de-duplication window, in seconds, at most 604800. `0` turns de-duplication off. Detection counters still count every occurrence. |
| `tags` | array of string | no |  | at most 64 items | 1.0.0 | Labels copied into the event, such as `lolbin` or `mitre:T1218.005`: each 1 to 128 characters, at most 64. |
| `upload` | [`Upload`](types.md#upload) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | When the event is sent to the server. |

Unknown fields are rejected.
